title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-21

ai_review.summary: Super soundboard capture of a high‑energy August 21 1968 Fillmore West show, with smoking Dark Star and Alligator, though the opening track suffers from cassette hiss.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as a classic 1968 set – dark, psychedelic jams like Dark Star, Alligator, St. Stephen and The Eleven are described as smoking, and Pigpen’s vocals and organ work receive special kudos. The recording is generally crisp soundboard material, but the first track sounds awful due to a fourth‑generation cassette master and some versions show duplicated tracks or a slightly flat high end.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for the musical performance and soundboard quality, with only minor technical complaints that keep the overall rating just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well‑balanced soundboard capture; first track suffers from cassette hiss/muffled quality, some versions have duplicated Schoolgirl tracks and a slightly flatter high‑frequency response.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, seamless suites (e.g., Cryptical>Other One>Cryptical) and a second‑set that mirrors the Live Dead material; overall flow is praised as cohesive despite occasional track duplication.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar tone is highlighted as fantastic – smoking Dark Star, mountain jam theme in Alligator, fire on Lovelight and early country twang on Midnight Hour; vocal volume low on Cryptical reprise.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass intertwines with Garcia in a “psychic dance” during Dark Star, providing strong support throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ is well mic'd and shines on Good Morning Little School Girl and Alligator; Pigpen’s organ/harp contributions are noted as stellar.
band_member_comments.Drums: Double‑drummer effect praised on Midnight Hour encore; drums drive the heating up of Alligator.
